meta.title: Create Image Audio Driven Video
meta.summary: Generate a talking video from a reference image, driving audio, and prompt text.

hero.title: Create Image Audio Driven Video

endpoint_summary.summary: Generate a talking video from a reference image, driving audio, and prompt text.

auth_requirements.title: Auth Requirements
items: Authentication is required via Authorization header.

preconditions.title: Preconditions
items: Upload the source file and create a file reference before calling this endpoint.
Successful requests return a Medux task record immediately. Use the task query or sync endpoints to track completion.
All file inputs must be uploaded and persisted as file references before submission.

fields.name: prompt_text
fields.description: Talking prompt text used to guide video generation.

fields.name: resolution
fields.description: Prompt image or prompt video frame resize target before generation. Default: 720p.

fields.name: model_id
fields.description: Image audio driven video model id. Default: image-audio-driven-video-default.

fields.name: code
fields.description:
Application response code.

| Code | Meaning |
| ---- | ------- |
| `0` | OK |
| `12` | Invalid input |
| `1401` | Insufficient credits |
| `1404` | Provider returned an error |
| `1405` | Provider request timed out |
| `13` | Authentication is required |
| `16` | Rate limit exceeded |
| `99` | Server error |

examples.title: Examples
examples.request_example:
curl -X POST https://api.medux.io/api/app/v1/generate/video/image_audio_driven \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $MEDUX_API_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model_id":"image-audio-driven-video-default","prompt_audio_file_id":"AUDIO_FILE_ID","prompt_image_file_id":"FILE_ID","prompt_text":"Hello from Medux","resolution":"720p"}'
examples.curl_command:
curl -X POST https://api.medux.io/api/app/v1/generate/video/image_audio_driven \
